title: Jinkun Chen
bodyMdx: ![Jinkun Chen](https://cdn.jinkunchen.com/notion-assets/17140d70fdf5805f8936f05797866cba.png) I am **Jinkun Chen** (he/him/his), a **Ph.D. student in Computer Science** at [Dalhousie University](https://www.dal.ca/) in Halifax, Canada. My research focuses on **explainable AI**, **AI for Science**, and **visualization**, with particular interests in fairness, open-ended co-evolution, and reliable long-term memory in language-model systems. [BIO](/bio) · [Publications](/publications) · [Contact](/connect) Alongside research, I teach at Dalhousie University and build technology through [Exorcat Technologies Ltd.](https://exorcat.com/) and [Jinnkunn Consulting Inc.](https://jinnkunn.com/). Explore my [teaching](/teaching), [work](/works), and [blog](/blog). [jinkun.chen@dal.ca](mailto:jinkun.chen@dal.ca) · [i@jinkunchen.com](mailto:i@jinkunchen.com)
